searchText: With the new endpoints for blobs, what are the thoughts of allowing blob transactions being covered in FOCIL? Yea. It does open the design space. We probably need ssz union for this, that is a container that is either IL transaction or a kzg commitment (assuming we reuse the same engine api) Why? if the tx is a type three tx then the builder knows what the commitment should be isn't it? But you need to broadcast the commitment over libp2p right, that's what I meant for the only container changes - Alice constraint bob the builder on what to build next week - The first step is alice needs to gossip the inclusion list to the p2p network so that everyone seen - But I think we dont want to gossip the IL txs here, we just want to gossip the kzg commitment here - So we need the IL tx which is a consensus type to realize kzg commitment
